title: Capability
description: I02: whether `target` supports `kind` at all (declared - a static manifest/descriptor claim) modeled as data distinct from whether that support was recently, actually verified (last_checked_at_utc/checked_configuration/max_age_seconds) - a declared capability with no recent, successful check is not usable, and neither is one whose check has gone stale. See is_capability_usable() in the Python reference client.

kind.description: Which capability - the same vocabulary as Operation.kind.

declared.description: Static: does target's own manifest/descriptor claim to support kind at all. Never proof it actually works.

checked_configuration.description: Opaque fingerprint/revision of the configuration under which last_checked_at_utc's check actually ran.
